cards.title: QM7-X 7095 · 单氘代位点设计：1_11 谱线位移最大（四选一）
cards.source: QM7-X, Hoja et al., Sci. Data 8, 43 (2021) https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-021-00812-2 ; data https://zenodo.org/records/4288677
cards.attribution: QM7-X（Hoja et al., Sci. Data 2021，CC BY 4.0）几何坐标原样。
cards.objective: 为替代法结构测定选择单氘代位点，使指定转动谱线位移最大（设计 = 推断的逆问题）。
cards.size: 输入与推理：分子最大原子间距（整分子转动惯量）。
cards.question: The supplied XYZ is the DFTB3+MBD-optimized geometry of QM7-X molecule 7095 (C4H8N2S, 15 atoms, angstrom); rows are counted from 1 after the two header lines. Model conditions: a rigid rotor at exactly the supplied geometry (no vibrational averaging, no centrifugal distortion); masses of the most abundant isotopes: C 12.000000 u, H 1.007825 u, N 14.003074 u, S 31.972071 u; rotational constants A ≥ B ≥ C are h/(8π²I) with I_a ≤ I_b ≤ I_c the principal moments of inertia about the centre of mass; h = 6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J s, 1 u = 1.66053906660×10⁻²⁷ kg. You will record the rotational spectrum of one singly deuterated isotopologue: exactly one of the hydrogen atoms H10, H12, H14, H15 (rows counted from 1 after the two XYZ header lines) is replaced by deuterium, D 2.014102 u, at the same position. Candidates: H10 is bonded to C1, the methyl carbon (CH3); H12 is bonded to N5, the thioamide N–H nitrogen; H14 is bonded to C7, the alkene carbon (C=C); H15 is bonded to C7, the alkene carbon (C=C). You want the largest change in the frequency of the J_KaKc = 1_11 ← 0_00 transition relative to the parent molecule (largest absolute shift). Exactly one candidate gives the largest shift. Which hydrogen should be substituted?

A.reason: 离质心最远（4.02 Å），但谱线位移取决于到相应主轴的距离，不是到质心的距离。

B.reason: 谱线位移 -37.62 MHz，小于正确项。

D.reason: 谱线位移 -60.92 MHz，小于正确项。

cards.title: QM7-X 7029 · 1_11 ← 0_00 转动跃迁频率（四选一）
cards.source: QM7-X, Hoja et al., Sci. Data 8, 43 (2021) https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-021-00812-2 ; data https://zenodo.org/records/4288677
cards.attribution: QM7-X（Hoja et al., Sci. Data 2021，CC BY 4.0）几何坐标原样。
cards.objective: 由分子几何预测刚性转子转动跃迁频率（几何 → 主转动惯量 → 转动常数 → J = 1 能级）。
cards.size: 输入与推理：分子最大原子间距（整分子转动惯量）。
cards.question: The supplied XYZ is the DFTB3+MBD-optimized geometry of QM7-X molecule 7029 (C4H8N2S, 15 atoms, angstrom); rows are counted from 1 after the two header lines. Model conditions: a rigid rotor at exactly the supplied geometry (no vibrational averaging, no centrifugal distortion); masses of the most abundant isotopes: C 12.000000 u, H 1.007825 u, N 14.003074 u, S 31.972071 u; rotational constants A ≥ B ≥ C are h/(8π²I) with I_a ≤ I_b ≤ I_c the principal moments of inertia about the centre of mass; h = 6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J s, 1 u = 1.66053906660×10⁻²⁷ kg. Predict the frequency of the J_KaKc = 1_11 ← 0_00 rotational transition of this molecule, in MHz.

A.reason: 能级标号对错：算成 1_01 ← 0_00 跃迁（B + C）。

B.reason: 套用线型分子公式 ν(J=1←0) = 2B，忽略了非对称陀螺 J = 1 能级按 K 分裂。

C.reason: 直接用输入坐标系中惯量张量的对角元当主转动惯量，没有对角化。

D.reason: 质心 → 惯量张量 → Jacobi 对角化 → A、B、C → 1_11 ← 0_00 = A + C。

cards.title: QM7-X 7040 · 位移 d1 处沿 A→B 路径的能量导数（四选一）
cards.source: QM7-X, Hoja et al., Sci. Data 8, 43 (2021) https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-021-00812-2 ; data https://zenodo.org/records/4288677
cards.attribution: QM7-X（Hoja et al., Sci. Data 2021），CC BY 4.0；原始 hdf5 中的坐标与 PBE0+MBD 总力。
cards.objective: 由位移结构处的原子力求沿指定路径的能量方向导数（局部斜率，不是有限能量差或稳定性判断）。
cards.size: 输入与推理：分子最大原子间距。
cards.question: Structures A and B of the same molecule share atom order and one Cartesian frame (angstrom). The table gives the total PBE0+MBD force on every atom at B (eV/angstrom), with F_i = −∂E/∂r_i. Along the straight path r_i(λ) = r_i(A) + λ[r_i(B) − r_i(A)], what is dE/dλ at λ = 1 (that is, at B), in eV? Do not realign, mass-weight or normalize the displacement.

A.reason: 只累加重原子，忽略氢原子的受力与位移。

B.reason: 按 A 处受力为零的梯形估计给出能量差，而题目问的是 B 处的导数。

C.reason: B 处沿给定路径方向的导数 = −Σ F_i(B)·(路径方向位移)；十进制与浮点实现一致。

D.reason: 逐原子取投影绝对值后相加，丢失相互抵消。

cards.question: The superconducting state of an atomically thin MA-TBG device (Tc about 0.5 K) was suppressed with magnetic fields perpendicular and parallel to the layers. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Cao et al., Nature 556, 43 (2018); numbers as reported in the paper). Estimate the in-plane critical field that orbital (Ginzburg-Landau thin-film) pair breaking would give for this thickness and coherence length, and compare it with the measurement. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

options.label: A
options.value: Orbital in-plane critical field ≈ 0.12 T. The measured 1.1 T is set by orbital pair breaking: the in-plane field destroys superconductivity through screening currents in the bilayer.

options.label: B
options.value: Orbital in-plane critical field ≈ 36.54 T. The orbital limit is far above the measured 1.1 T, which lies close to the Pauli limit: in-plane superconductivity is destroyed by Zeeman (paramagnetic) pair breaking, not by orbital currents.

options.label: C
options.value: Orbital in-plane critical field ≈ 36.54 T. The measured 1.1 T is set by orbital pair breaking: the in-plane field destroys superconductivity through screening currents in the bilayer.

options.label: D
options.value: Orbital in-plane critical field ≈ 0.12 T. The orbital limit is far above the measured 1.1 T, which lies close to the Pauli limit: in-plane superconductivity is destroyed by Zeeman (paramagnetic) pair breaking, not by orbital currents.

A.reason: 数值来自错误做法（套用垂直场的 GL 公式 Φ0/(2πξ²)，忽略了平行场下轨道效应受膜厚 d 限制。），结论也是原文排除的解释。

B.reason: 数值按原文数据计算正确，结论即原文结论（Magnetic field response (p. 5): d ≈ 0.6 nm would imply ~36 T; dependence interpreted as paramagnetic pair breaking）。

C.reason: 数值正确，但结论是原文排除的解释：原文指出原子级厚度使轨道极限约 36 T，远高于实测，因而排除轨道机制。（Magnetic field response (p. 5)）

D.reason: 结论措辞取自原文，但数值来自错误做法：套用垂直场的 GL 公式 Φ0/(2πξ²)，忽略了平行场下轨道效应受膜厚 d 限制。

cards.question: Twisted bilayer graphene near the magic angle (MA-TBG) becomes superconducting when doped slightly away from half filling of its flat band. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E3 from Cao et al., Nature 556, 43 (2018); numbers as reported in the paper). Estimate the mean spacing between the carriers that form the condensate (one over the square root of their areal density) and compare it with the coherence length. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

options.label: A
options.value: Mean carrier spacing ≈ 8.2 nm. The coherence length is many times this spacing, as in a conventional weak-coupling BCS superconductor in which each pair overlaps many others.

options.label: B
options.value: Mean carrier spacing ≈ 25.8 nm. The coherence length is many times this spacing, as in a conventional weak-coupling BCS superconductor in which each pair overlaps many others.

options.label: C
options.value: Mean carrier spacing ≈ 8.2 nm. The coherence length is only about twice this spacing, so a pair is hardly larger than the distance between carriers: MA-TBG is a strong-coupling superconductor close to the BCS-BEC crossover.

options.label: D
options.value: Mean carrier spacing ≈ 25.8 nm. The coherence length is only about twice this spacing, so a pair is hardly larger than the distance between carriers: MA-TBG is a strong-coupling superconductor close to the BCS-BEC crossover.

A.reason: 数值来自错误做法（用栅极诱导的总密度 |n|（从电中性点算起）求间距，忽略了量子振荡显示真正参与的只是从半填充算起的 n′。），结论也是原文排除的解释。

B.reason: 数值正确，但结论是原文排除的解释：原文据 ξ 与粒子间距同量级判断为强耦合、接近 BCS-BEC 交叉；弱耦合 BCS 的结论与之相反。（Discussion (p. 8-9): Tc/TF and ξ vs spacing place MA-TBG far from weak-coupling BCS）

cards.question: STM topographs of twisted bilayer graphene near the magic angle give the moiré wavelength along the three principal directions of the moiré lattice. The graphene lattice constant is a = 0.246 nm; an unstrained twist θ gives a single moiré period λ = a / (2 sin(θ/2)). The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E3 from Kerelsky et al., Nature 572, 95 (2019); numbers as reported in the paper). A strain-unaware analysis treats the triangle formed by the three wavelengths as an equilateral triangle of the same area. Find the twist angle this gives and decide what the unequal wavelengths mean. (a = 0.246 nm.) Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

options.label: A
options.value: Equal-area twist angle ≈ 1.18°. The three directions belong to regions with three different twist angles; each wavelength gives its own local twist directly.

options.label: B
options.value: Equal-area twist angle ≈ 1.03°. The wavelengths differ because one layer carries a small uniaxial heterostrain (about 0.7 %; a full fit gives θ ≈ 1.15°); the equal-area estimate stays close to the true twist, whereas any single direction would misjudge it.

options.label: C
options.value: Equal-area twist angle ≈ 1.18°. The wavelengths differ because one layer carries a small uniaxial heterostrain (about 0.7 %; a full fit gives θ ≈ 1.15°); the equal-area estimate stays close to the true twist, whereas any single direction would misjudge it.

options.label: D
options.value: Equal-area twist angle ≈ 1.03°. The three directions belong to regions with three different twist angles; each wavelength gives its own local twist directly.

A.reason: 数值正确，但结论是原文排除的解释：三个波长来自同一莫尔晶格的三个方向；原文用一层的单轴异质应变解释，而不是三个转角不同的畴。（Supplement S1; main text p. 2 (single moiré lattice with strain)）

B.reason: 结论措辞取自原文，但数值来自错误做法：只用最长的一个方向（13.72 nm）代入 λ = a/(2 sin θ/2)，忽略三个方向不等。

C.reason: 数值按原文数据计算正确，结论即原文结论（Supplement S1: fit θT = 1.152°, strain 0.68 %; equal-area estimate 1.18°）。

D.reason: 数值来自错误做法（只用最长的一个方向（13.72 nm）代入 λ = a/(2 sin θ/2)，忽略三个方向不等。），结论也是原文排除的解释。

cards.objective: 比较 C3 对称破缺随能量与掺杂的变化，排除应变、针尖与过度结论，判断电子向列性。
cards.size: 推理：莫尔晶胞（约 13 nm）。
cards.question: Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy maps the local density of states (LDOS) over one moiré cell of twisted bilayer graphene at 1.10°, at several gate dopings. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E5 from Kerelsky et al., Nature 572, 95 (2019); numbers as reported in the paper). Which explanation of the C3 symmetry breaking is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: An asymmetric STM tip: the anisotropy is an imaging artefact that does not depend on the electronic states.

options.label: B
options.value: Electronic nematicity driven by the states at the Fermi level: strain only selects a direction, while the size of the C3 breaking follows the Fermi level and grows in the correlated state.

options.label: C
options.value: Heterostrain alone: a fixed lattice distortion breaks C3 by the same amount at every energy and doping.

options.label: D
options.value: A charge density wave that breaks translational symmetry has been established in these maps, and it causes the C3 breaking.

A.reason: 与 E3、E4 矛盾：针尖假象与能量、掺杂无关，解释不了破缺集中在费米能并在关联态增强。（Fig. 5 discussion）

B.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Fig. 5 discussion: Fermi-surface driven breaking of C3, possible nematic order）。

C.reason: 与 E3、E4 矛盾：应变是固定的晶格畸变，不会让最强破缺随费米能移动。（Fig. 5 discussion: some breaking expected from strain, but maximum at the Fermi level）

D.reason: 与 E5 矛盾：原文明确说平移对称破缺仍未确定，因样品不均匀无法做傅里叶分析。（Fig. 5 discussion: translational symmetry breaking remains an open question）

cards.size: 推理：莫尔晶胞（约 13 nm）。
cards.question: Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations of a magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MA-TBG) device are mapped against carrier density n and magnetic field on the hole side; ns is the density that fills one superlattice band (4 electrons per moiré cell). The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E5 from Cao et al., Nature 556, 43 (2018); numbers as reported in the paper). Which explanation of the extra Landau fan is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: A doubled unit cell from strain or a charge density wave, which halves the filling factors of the ordinary single-particle bands.

options.label: B
options.value: Small Fermi pockets of quasiparticles counted from the half-filling correlated insulator, with half the usual degeneracy; the carriers above the superconducting dome are only |n| - ns/2.

options.label: C
options.value: Fractional Landau fans of the Hofstadter butterfly of the moiré superlattice.

options.label: D
options.value: The ordinary single-particle Fermi surface of all |n| carriers, with the usual four-fold degeneracy.

A.reason: 与 E1 矛盾：晶胞加倍要求事先破缺自旋或谷简并，但从电中性点和 −ns 出发的扇仍是四重简并。（Quantum oscillations (p. 7): would require spin or valley degeneracy to be broken a priori）

B.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Quantum oscillations (p. 8): small Fermi surfaces from the correlated insulating state; halved degeneracy）。

C.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：Hofstadter 分形通常要 10 T 以上才明显，而这个扇在约 1 T 就出现。（Quantum oscillations (p. 7): Hofstadter features need fields > 10 T）

D.reason: 与 E4 矛盾：半填充附近测得 M = 2，面积随 |n| − ns/2 变化，不是全部载流子的大费米面。（Quantum oscillations (p. 8): M = 2 near the correlated state）

cards.objective: 比较 vHs 间距与峰宽随转角的变化，判断决定关联态的是单个 vHs 的带宽（U/t），而不是两峰合并。
cards.size: 推理：莫尔晶胞（约 13 nm）。
cards.question: Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy on the AA sites of twisted bilayer graphene measures the two van Hove singularity (vHs) peaks of the flat bands at twist angles from 3.48° down to 0.79°. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Kerelsky et al., Nature 572, 95 (2019); numbers as reported in the paper). Which explanation of why correlated states appear near 1.1° is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: The 55 meV vHs splitting at 1.1° is an artefact of heterostrain and does not reflect the band structure.

options.label: B
options.value: Phonon-mediated pairing, so correlated states follow the largest density of states, which occurs where the peaks merge (about 0.8°).

options.label: C
options.value: The bandwidth of each individual vHs is smallest near 1.1°, so the ratio of Coulomb repulsion to bandwidth (U/t) is largest there, favouring electronic rather than phonon-driven pairing.

options.label: D
options.value: The two vHs peaks merge into a single density-of-states maximum at the superconducting angle.

A.reason: 与 E4 矛盾：不同应变的样品劈裂相近，紧束缚模型也能重现，排除应变假象。（Supplement S4: similar splitting at different strain; reproduced by tight binding）

B.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：态密度最大处在两峰几乎合并的 0.79°，而超导出现在约 1.1°。（Discussion (p. 7): phonon scenarios favour maximal DOS; observed at ~1.1°）

C.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（p. 4 and Discussion (p. 7): width minimized near 1.10°; superconductivity where U/t is largest）。

D.reason: 与 E1 矛盾：1.10° 时两峰仍相距约 55 meV，并未合并。（p. 3: two distinct peaks 55 meV apart at 1.10°）

cards.title: 转角石墨烯 STS · 7.5 meV 能隙的性质（证据排除题）
cards.source: Kerelsky et al., "Maximized electron interactions at the magic angle in twisted bilayer graphene", Nature 572, 95 (2019); arXiv:1812.08776v2 ("Magic Angle Spectroscopy")；证据卡逐条记录原文位置（docs/assets/families/evidence/kerelsky2019-gap.json）
cards.attribution: 事实数据取自 Kerelsky et al., Nature 572, 95 (2019)；arXiv:1812.08776（逐条转述，未转载文字或图）；证据卡见 docs/assets/families/evidence/。
cards.objective: 依据能隙只在 vHs 到达费米能时出现等观测，判断它是多体关联能隙。
cards.size: 推理：莫尔晶胞（约 13 nm）。
cards.question: Scanning tunnelling spectra on the AA sites of twisted bilayer graphene at 1.10° and 1.15° are taken while a back gate changes the carrier density. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Kerelsky et al., Nature 572, 95 (2019); numbers as reported in the paper). Which interpretation of the 7.5 meV gap is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: A single-particle band gap of the moiré bands, present whatever the filling.

options.label: B
options.value: The same gap that transport measures, with the same size, so transport fully captures it.

options.label: C
options.value: An artefact of band bending induced by the STM tip.

options.label: D
options.value: A many-body (correlation) gap: it opens only when the flat-band vHs is at the Fermi level, and it is the spectroscopic counterpart of the half-filling insulator, smaller in transport because of disorder averaging.

A.reason: 与 E1、E2 矛盾：单粒子带隙与填充无关，应在电中性时也存在，但只有 vHs 到达费米能时才出现。（p. 5）

B.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：STM 能隙明显大于输运激活能（原文归因于输运中的无序平均）。（p. 5: STM gap bigger than the transport activation energy）

C.reason: 与 E4 矛盾：针尖诱导的能带弯曲只在大转角、态密度小时明显，在这些小转角可忽略。（Supplement S4）

D.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（p. 5: emergence only at the Fermi level is direct evidence of many-body character）。

cards.question: Small-angle neutron scattering is measured on single crystals of the cubic chiral magnet MnSi (Tc = 29.5 K), with the neutron beam parallel to the applied magnetic field. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E5 from Mühlbauer et al., Science 323, 915 (2009); numbers as reported in the paper). Which interpretation of the A phase is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: The conical phase, with the helix wave vector along the field.

options.label: B
options.value: A single helix with its wave vector perpendicular to the field (the earlier interpretation), giving one pair of spots per domain.

options.label: C
options.value: A lattice of skyrmion lines: three helices at 120 degrees to each other in the plane perpendicular to the field, a long-range-ordered spin crystal oriented by the field and decoupled from the atomic lattice.

options.label: D
options.value: A multi-Q magnetic structure locked to the atomic lattice, as in the rare-earth magnets.

A.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：锥形相的斑点沿磁场方向，而 A 相的斑点在严格垂直于磁场的平面内。（Main text p. 3-4; Fig. 1A）

B.reason: 与 E2 矛盾：单一螺旋每个畴只给一对斑点，而实测是规则六边形上的六个斑点。（Main text p. 2-3: the A phase had been believed to be a single-Q helix）

C.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Main text pp. 3-5: multi-Q structure of three helices perpendicular to B, independent of lattice orientation）。

D.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：被原子晶格钉住的结构会随晶轴取向改变图样，而这里的六重图样只跟随磁场。（Main text p. 6: rare-earth multi-Q structures are strongly pinned to the lattice）

cards.question: Methylene-bridged glycoluril dimers, called molecular clips, bind a guest inside a cleft between two roughly parallel dialkoxyaromatic side walls. With the planar cationic dyes used here the guest stacks between the walls and its cationic group sits at the ureidyl carbonyl portals. Two clips differing only in their walls were made: H1 with naphthalene walls and H2 with anthracene walls. Apparent 1:1 binding constants Ka were measured by direct or competitive UV/Vis or fluorescence titration in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) at room temperature, every titration in duplicate. You are assembling a clip-dye reporter pair that has to work at low micromolar concentrations, so it needs a tight 1:1 complex. The attached candidates.txt describes four candidate structures, all of them prepared and measured in Vincent et al., Chem. Eur. J. (2025). The candidate must satisfy: (affinity) the measured binding constant in PBS at room temperature is at least 5 × 10^6 M^-1. Exactly one of the four does so in the measured data, which is not shown to you. Which candidate pair should you choose?

C.reason: 不满足约束 affinity：主体已是蒽墙，但客体少一个稠环：实测 Ka = 1.50 × 10⁴ M⁻¹，是同主体下 NMeAc 的 1/717。

D.reason: 不满足约束 affinity：主体与客体都少一个稠环：实测 Ka = 6.34 × 10³ M⁻¹，为四者最低。

cards.objective: 在 C4a（大环主体）上按实测选择性比值选出柔性门户的受体，而非绝对结合最强的那个。
cards.size: 输入与推理：大环空腔内的 C–H···X⁻ 接触长度（约 0.31 nm）。
cards.question: A bambus[6]uril is a macrocycle of six glycoluril units joined by six methylene bridges. One inorganic anion binds in the centre of the cavity, held by the twelve C-H...X- contacts of the glycoluril methine protons, and the substituents on the nitrogen atoms sit on the two portals. Bromide is a small spherical anion; nitrate is larger and trigonal planar. Apparent 1:1 association constants Ka were measured by isothermal titration calorimetry on tetrabutylammonium salts at 298.15 K, with standard deviations below 17 %. You need a receptor that picks nitrate out of a solution in which bromide is present at a similar concentration, so absolute affinity is not enough: the receptor has to prefer nitrate. The attached candidates.txt describes four candidate structures, all of them prepared and measured in Rando et al., Chem. Sci. (2025). The candidate must satisfy: (selectivity) the measured apparent association constant for nitrate is at least 1.5 times the one for bromide under the same conditions. Exactly one of the four does so in the measured data, which is not shown to you. Which candidate receptor system should you choose?

A.reason: 不满足约束 selectivity：四者中绝对结合常数最高（Ka(NO₃⁻) = 3.0 × 10⁹ M⁻¹），但比值只有 0.31，仍偏好 Br⁻ 约 3.3 倍。“结合最强”不等于“选择性方向正确”。

B.reason: 不满足约束 selectivity：换溶剂不改变大环几何：实测比值 0.11，在乙腈中仍偏好 Br⁻（9 倍），与在氯仿中同向。

C.reason: 实测值满足全部目标约束，且是原文选定的结构（Results and discussion：“BnBU preferentially binds NO3- over Br- with a selectivity of 3 in chloroform”，而 BU1 在氯仿与乙腈中都偏好 Br⁻（22 与 9 倍）；Table 1 的 NO3- 与 Br- 行）。

D.reason: 不满足约束 selectivity：实测 Ka(NO₃⁻)/Ka(Br⁻) = 0.046：强烈偏好较小的球形 Br⁻（22 倍），方向与目标相反。

cards.question: Conformer THREE of 3-hydroxy-2-butenamide is the enol in which the hydroxyl H has been rotated away, so that the hydroxyl O and the amide carbonyl O face each other without a hydrogen between them. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Altun, Bleda & Trindle, Molecules 26, 2623 (2021); numbers as reported in the paper). Which interpretation of the O···O contact in THREE is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: No hydrogen bond: the O···O contact is repulsive, and a bond path with a critical point is not enough on its own to establish a hydrogen bond.

options.label: B
options.value: A strong hydrogen bond, since the density at the critical point is appreciable.

options.label: D
options.value: A weak O-H···O hydrogen bond, proved by the bond path and its critical point.

A.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（AIM and NCI sections: THREE has a repulsive O···O interaction despite the density at the BCP）。

B.reason: 与 E2、E3、E4 矛盾：没有红移、成环振动最软，与强氢键的预期全部相反。（NCI section; OH mode; CCC bend）

C.reason: 与 E1、E2 矛盾：拉普拉斯量为正，表明是闭壳层相互作用，不是共价作用。（AIM section: positive Laplacian = closed-shell interaction）

D.reason: 与 E2、E3 矛盾：NCI 为排斥，且 O–H 伸缩没有红移，键径本身不能证明氢键。（NCI section; OH mode）

options.label: C

cards.question: S0.xyz and X.xyz each contain one structure of formula C4H8N2S1 (angstrom). X has been rigidly rotated and translated, and its atom order may differ from S0. Treat structures that interconvert only by rotation about single bonds as the same compound. Which describes X relative to S0?

options.label: A
options.value: the same compound as S0 (only conformation and/or orientation differ)

options.label: B
options.value: an enantiomer of S0 (its non-superimposable mirror image)

options.label: C
options.value: a diastereomer of S0 (a stereoisomer that is not its mirror image)

options.label: D
options.value: a constitutional isomer of S0 (same formula, different bonding)

A.reason: 键连相同且所有立体描述符一致：仅构象/取向不同。

B.reason: 不满足“全部立体中心反转、双键不变”的镜像关系。

C.reason: 不是“键连相同而构型部分不同”的情形。

D.reason: 键连图相同，不是构造异构体。

cards.title: WP6 · 羧酸根 C20–O22 键长（四选一）
cards.attribution: SAMPL9 挑战赛 WP6 主体结构（MIT），坐标原样。
cards.objective: 测定主体分子中按化学含义指定的键长（羧酸根 C–O，离域键），原子由成键关系与官能团确认。
cards.size: 输入：主体分子最大原子间距；推理：两成键原子间距。
cards.question: The supplied XYZ is one WP6 (carboxylated pillar[6]arene, all twelve carboxyl groups deprotonated) host conformer from the SAMPL9 host–guest challenge (150 atoms, angstrom); rows are counted from 1 after the two header lines. In this supplied structure, atoms C20 (row 20) and O22 (row 22) form the delocalized C–O bond of a carboxylate group (C20 is the carboxylate carbon COO⁻, O22 one of its two terminal oxygens). What is this bond length?

A.reason: 两指定原子的欧氏距离；另以 Decimal 实现复核。

B.reason: 量成 C20 的另一根键（到 C14）。

C.reason: 多数了一根键：量成 O22 到 C20 之外的 C14 的距离。

D.reason: 量到最近的另一个同种元素原子（O12，未成键）。

cards.title: 3-羟基-2-丁烯酰胺构象 TWO · O–H···O 给体–受体距离（四选一）
cards.source: Altun, Bleda & Trindle, Molecules 26, 2623 (2021), DOI 10.3390/molecules26092623 (SI coordinate tables, pages 3–6)
cards.attribution: Altun, Bleda & Trindle, Molecules 26, 2623 (2021)，CC BY 4.0；SI 坐标表原样。
cards.objective: 测定分子内氢键 D–H···A 的距离或角度，区分 D···A 与 H···A、区分角度顶点。
cards.size: 输入：分子最大原子间距；推理：给体–受体或氢–受体距离。
cards.question: The supplied XYZ is conformer TWO of 3-hydroxy-2-butenamide (enol form, hydroxyl toward the amide carbonyl), a computed structure from Altun, Bleda & Trindle (2021) (14 atoms, angstrom). In this conformer, O6, the hydroxyl oxygen (OH), is covalently bonded to H5, and O14, the carbonyl oxygen (C=O), is the candidate hydrogen-bond acceptor (rows 6, 5 and 14, counted from 1 after the two XYZ header lines). What is the donor–acceptor distance O6···O14?

A.reason: 量成 H···A 距离，而不是给体与受体两个重原子之间的距离。

B.reason: 按指定原子直接计算；成键关系由共价半径规则确认。

C.reason: 沿 D–H 与 H···A 两段折线相加，当成给体–受体距离。

D.reason: 量到了另一个杂原子 N11（不是题目指定的受体）。

cards.title: 3-羟基-2-丁烯酰胺构象 FIVE · O–H···N 的 H···N 距离（四选一）

cards.attribution: Altun, Bleda & Trindle, Molecules 26, 2623 (2021)，CC BY 4.0；SI 坐标表原样。
cards.objective: 测定分子内氢键 D–H···A 的距离或角度，区分 D···A 与 H···A、区分角度顶点。

What is the hydrogen–acceptor distance H4···N11?

A.reason: 假设氢键是直线：用 D···A 减去 D–H 键长。

C.reason: 量成给体与受体重原子之间的距离，而不是 H···A。

D.reason: 量到了另一个杂原子 O10（不是题目指定的受体）。

cards.title: BCD · 桥连氧处的 C–O–C 键角（四选一）
cards.attribution: SAMPL9 challenge contributors · CC BY 4.0；PDB 转换为 XYZ，保留原子顺序与坐标。
cards.objective: 根据已给连接关系，表征 β-环糊精构象中桥连氧的局部 C–O–C 键角。
cards.size: 输入：全部重原子的最大中心距；推理：题目指定原子子集的最大中心距。不是溶液尺寸或空腔直径。
cards.question: The supplied XYZ is one beta-cyclodextrin host conformer (147 atoms, angstrom). Atoms C4–O3–C37 form the bridging ether linkage between two glucose units, O3 bonded to C4 and C37 as in the source PDB CONECT record (C4 = row 4, O3 = row 45, C37 = row 37; rows counted from 1 after the two XYZ header lines). What is the C4–O3–C37 bond angle at O3 in this supplied conformer?

A.reason: 测成相邻原子 C4 处的键角，而非题目指定的顶点 O3。

B.reason: 直接套用理想杂化角 109.47（sp3 tetrahedral），没有测量这一构象。

C.reason: 测成相邻原子 C37 处的键角，而非题目指定的顶点 O3。

D.reason: 按向量夹角公式在指定顶点计算；另以 atan2 实现复核。

cards.question: A right-handed cholesteric liquid crystal is made by doping the nematic E44 with 2.62 wt% of the chiral dopant R5011 and is studied in a planar cell between 20 and 90 °C. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Shaban et al., Materials 17, 5080 (2024); numbers as reported in the paper). Compute the expected width of the reflection band at 20 °C from the pitch and the indices, and choose the interpretation of the temperature dependence. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

options.label: A
options.value: Expected band width ≈ 85.9 nm. Up to about 60 °C the pitch stays essentially constant and the band narrows because the birefringence falls as orientational order decreases; above about 60 °C the red shift of the centre shows the pitch lengthening (weaker twisting).

options.label: B
options.value: Expected band width ≈ 592.7 nm. Up to about 60 °C the pitch stays essentially constant and the band narrows because the birefringence falls as orientational order decreases; above about 60 °C the red shift of the centre shows the pitch lengthening (weaker twisting).

options.label: C
options.value: Expected band width ≈ 592.7 nm. The band narrows because the helical pitch shortens on heating, and the late red shift comes from a rise of the average refractive index.

options.label: D
options.value: Expected band width ≈ 85.9 nm. The band narrows because the helical pitch shortens on heating, and the late red shift comes from a rise of the average refractive index.

A.reason: 数值按原文数据计算正确，结论即原文结论（Section 3.5: Δλ decrease attributed to diminishing Δn; red shift above ~60 °C = pitch elongation）。

B.reason: 结论措辞取自原文，但数值来自错误做法：用平均折射率 ⟨n⟩ 代替双折射 Δn，算出的是反射带中心而不是带宽。

C.reason: 数值来自错误做法（用平均折射率 ⟨n⟩ 代替双折射 Δn，算出的是反射带中心而不是带宽。），结论也是原文排除的解释。

D.reason: 数值正确，但结论是原文排除的解释：中心在 20–60 °C 几乎不动，说明螺距基本不变；带宽变窄来自 Δn 下降，而非螺距变短。（Section 3.5）

cards.question: Two reactive chiral dopants built on isosorbide, LRCD (from L-isosorbide) and RRCD (from D-isosorbide), were each mixed into the same reactive nematic host and photopolymerised as planar cholesteric coatings. Take the average refractive index of the host as 1.6. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Dinc et al., Org. Chem. Front. (2024); numbers as reported in the paper). From the two coatings, compute the ratio of the apparent helical twisting powers, |HTP(LRCD)| / HTP(RRCD), and choose the explanation. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

options.label: A
options.value: |HTP(LRCD)| / HTP(RRCD) ≈ 0.90. LRCD twists the host only about three quarters as strongly; as enantiomers the two have the same intrinsic |HTP|, so the deficit reflects the lower enantiomeric excess of LRCD, inherited from L-sorbitol that contains some D-sorbitol.

options.label: B
options.value: |HTP(LRCD)| / HTP(RRCD) ≈ 0.76. LRCD twists the host only about three quarters as strongly; as enantiomers the two have the same intrinsic |HTP|, so the deficit reflects the lower enantiomeric excess of LRCD, inherited from L-sorbitol that contains some D-sorbitol.

options.label: C
options.value: |HTP(LRCD)| / HTP(RRCD) ≈ 0.90. LRCD and RRCD are not true mirror images but diastereomers, so their intrinsic twisting powers differ; enantiomeric purity plays no role.

options.label: D
options.value: |HTP(LRCD)| / HTP(RRCD) ≈ 0.76. LRCD and RRCD are not true mirror images but diastereomers, so their intrinsic twisting powers differ; enantiomeric purity plays no role.

A.reason: 结论措辞取自原文，但数值来自错误做法：只比较两个反射波长（λR/λL），忽略两种涂层的掺杂浓度不同。

B.reason: 数值按原文数据计算正确，结论即原文结论（Results, last paragraph: ratio of apparent HTPs 76 %, in agreement with the ee from optical rotation）。

C.reason: 数值来自错误做法（只比较两个反射波长（λR/λL），忽略两种涂层的掺杂浓度不同。），结论也是原文排除的解释。

cards.question: The nematic E44 was doped with the chiral dopant R5011 (right-handed) or with its enantiomer S5011 (left-handed), and the mobile ions were measured by low-frequency dielectric spectroscopy. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E5 from Shaban et al., Materials 17, 5080 (2024); numbers as reported in the paper). Which explanation of the extra ions is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: Any chiral dopant dissociates into ions in E44, whichever its handedness.

options.label: B
options.value: The right-handed helical order itself generates or traps the ions.

options.label: C
options.value: The ions come from the cell (alignment layers and electrodes), and the cell geometry controls them.

options.label: D
options.value: Impurity ions carried by this batch of R5011 (from manufacture or later contamination or degradation), unrelated to its handedness.

D.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Section 3.3 and Conclusions: R5011 as received contained more impurity ions; handedness not associated with the ionic response）。

cards.question: Dihydrogen isotopologues can be separated in a nanoporous framework by kinetic quantum sieving: the thermal de Broglie wavelength of H2 is longer than that of D2, so in a pore whose aperture is comparable to that wavelength H2 meets the higher diffusion barrier and the heavier D2 diffuses faster; the effect grows as the temperature falls. All four candidates below are rigid frameworks, so framework flexibility plays no part, and the paper treats them as lacking accessible open metal sites, although its Zeo++ analysis does report an open metal site density for one of them (noted in candidates.txt). Each framework was exposed to a 1:1 D2:H2 mixture at 100 mbar and 30 K for 10 min, and the selectivity S(D2/H2) and the D2 uptake were then read off the thermal desorption spectrum. You need the sorbent for an enrichment stage: it has to reach a useful separation factor and still take up enough D2 per gram for a cycle to be worth running. The attached candidates.txt describes four candidate structures, all of them prepared and measured in Chetry et al., ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces (2026). The candidate must satisfy: (selectivity) the measured D2/H2 selectivity at an exposure temperature of 30 K is at least 12; (capacity) the measured D2 uptake under the same conditions is at least 2 mmol g^-1. Exactly one of the four does so in the measured data, which is not shown to you. Which candidate framework should you choose?

options.label: A
options.value: UTSA-16(Co): UTSA-16(Co), a cobalt citrate framework

options.label: B
options.value: Cu-tetrazolate: Cu-tetrazolate, a copper tetrazolate framework

options.label: C
options.value: Ag-Bpz: Ag-Bpz, a silver bipyrazolate framework

A.reason: 实测值满足全部目标约束，且是原文选定的结构（Conclusions：“Cu-tetrazolate (3.2-3.6 A, S > 16 at 30 K) and UTSA-16(Co) (3.4-4.4 A, S = 15) demonstrate high selectivity, although with inherently limited uptake”，并把 Cu-4Py-Me 列为“practical compromise”；Results 给出四者的 S 与 D₂ 吸附量）。

B.reason: 不满足约束 capacity：孔口最窄、选择性确实最高（原文 > 16），但实测 D₂ 吸附量只有 0.2 mmol g⁻¹，容量差一个数量级。“孔越窄越好”在容量上立刻失效。

C.reason: 不满足约束 selectivity：孔口（3.5 Å）与最窄的一档相当，却只测到 5.5 的选择性：主要孔容来自 3.5 与 8 Å 两档且骨架高度互穿，原文把它较低的选择性与吸附量归于这种互穿结构。“孔口窄”不足以保证筛分。

D.reason: 不满足约束 selectivity：孔口 5.5 Å 远宽于量子筛分所需，实测选择性只有 8，未达 12；它的吸附量最高（9.7 mmol g⁻¹）却不解决选择性。

cards.question: The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of rutile (TiO2, COD 9004141) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (O = 8, Ti = 22). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

A.reason: 普通允许反射，非零。

B.reason: 强度较弱（|F|/F000=0.172），但不为零，弱不等于消光。

cards.question: The table lists every atom of one conventional cubic cell of silicon (Si, COD 9008565). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (Si = 14). For radiation of wavelength 1.54060 Å and first-order Bragg diffraction, at what angle 2θ does the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity appear?

A.reason: 报告了 θ 而非 2θ。

cards.title: 卤化物钙钛矿 · 掺 Rb 的吸收边位移 → 带隙变化 → 八面体倾转（证据题）
cards.source: Filip, Eperon, Snaith & Giustino, "Steric engineering of metal-halide perovskites with tunable optical band gaps", Nat. Commun. 5, 5757 (2014), doi:10.1038/ncomms6757；证据卡逐条记录原文位置（docs/assets/families/evidence/filip2014-rbcs.json）
cards.attribution: 事实数据取自 Filip et al., Nat. Commun. 5, 5757 (2014)（版权归出版方，仅使用事实与数值）（逐条转述，未转载文字或图）；证据卡见 docs/assets/families/evidence/。
cards.objective: 由吸收边波长换算带隙变化，判断小阳离子通过加大八面体倾转而增大带隙。
cards.size: 推理：Pb–I–Pb 连接（约 0.64 nm）。
cards.question: Thin films of the all-inorganic perovskites RbxCs1-xPbI3 are made by mixing the small cation Rb+ into CsPbI3, and their optical absorption is measured. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Filip et al., Nat. Commun. 5, 5757 (2014); numbers as reported in the paper). Using E = hc/lambda with hc = 1239.84 eV nm, compute the change of the optical gap from x = 0 to x = 0.2 (in eV) and choose the interpretation. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

options.label: A
options.value: Change of the optical gap ~ 0.075 eV. The shift comes from the electronic states of Rb+ itself, which form a new band edge; the tilt of the octahedra plays no part.

options.label: B
options.value: Change of the optical gap ~ 0.075 eV. The gap widens: the smaller Rb+ lets the PbI6 octahedra tilt further from the straight Pb-I-Pb geometry, and a larger tilt raises the gap (the calculations had predicted a 40 nm blue shift).

options.label: C
options.value: Change of the optical gap ~ -0.075 eV. The gap widens: the smaller Rb+ lets the PbI6 octahedra tilt further from the straight Pb-I-Pb geometry, and a larger tilt raises the gap (the calculations had predicted a 40 nm blue shift).

options.label: D
options.value: Change of the optical gap ~ -0.075 eV. The shift comes from the electronic states of Rb+ itself, which form a new band edge; the tilt of the octahedra plays no part.

A.reason: 数值正确，但结论是原文排除的解释：阳离子的电子态离带边几个 eV，去掉阳离子后能带几乎不变；原文把带隙变化归于八面体倾转。（Main text p. 2; Fig. 1b (cation states several eV from the band edges)）

B.reason: 数值按原文数据计算正确，结论即原文结论（Main text, Rb/Cs experiment: blue shift assigned to the more pronounced octahedral tilt; predicted shift 40 nm）。

C.reason: 结论措辞取自原文，但数值来自错误做法：把波长变短（蓝移）当成带隙变小，符号取反。

D.reason: 数值来自错误做法（把波长变短（蓝移）当成带隙变小，符号取反。），结论也是原文排除的解释。

cards.title: 卤化物钙钛矿 · 带隙由什么结构参数控制（证据排除题）
cards.source: Filip, Eperon, Snaith & Giustino, "Steric engineering of metal-halide perovskites with tunable optical band gaps", Nat. Commun. 5, 5757 (2014), doi:10.1038/ncomms6757；证据卡逐条记录原文位置（docs/assets/families/evidence/filip2014-angle.json）
cards.attribution: 事实数据取自 Filip et al., Nat. Commun. 5, 5757 (2014)（版权归出版方，仅使用事实与数值）（逐条转述，未转载文字或图）；证据卡见 docs/assets/families/evidence/。
cards.objective: 比较阳离子电子态、键长、八面体畸变与键角的作用，判断带隙由最大的 Pb–I–Pb 键角控制。
cards.size: 推理：Pb–I–Pb 连接（约 0.64 nm）。
cards.question: First-principles calculations map the band gap of lead-iodide perovskites APbI3 (corner-sharing PbI6 octahedra with a cation A in the cavities) across many real and hypothetical cations. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Filip et al., Nat. Commun. 5, 5757 (2014); numbers as reported in the paper). Which explanation of how the cation tunes the band gap is consistent with all of these facts?

options.label: A
options.value: Distortion of the PbI6 octahedra themselves dominates the gap.

options.label: B
options.value: Changes of the Pb-I bond length dominate the gap.

options.label: C
options.value: The orbitals of the cation form the band edges and set the gap directly.

options.label: D
options.value: The gap is set by the largest Pb-I-Pb bond angle, that is by the octahedral tilt; the cation acts only through its steric size, by controlling that tilt.

A.reason: 与 E2 矛盾：实测八面体几乎正则，而且完全正则的八面体模型已能重现带隙随键角的变化。（Main text p. 2: the measured octahedra are regular to within 0.1 per cent and 4 degrees）

B.reason: 与 E4 矛盾：键长差异只带来约 0.2 eV，而键角变化可达约 1 eV。（Fig. 2 caption: bond-length spread accounts for about 0.2 eV）

C.reason: 与 E1 矛盾：去掉阳离子后带隙附近的能带几乎不变，说明带边不是阳离子轨道。（Fig. 1b: the cation states are far from the gap）

D.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Abstract and Fig. 3b: the gap correlates with the largest metal-halide-metal bond angle, tuned through the steric size of the cation）。

cards.title: SiO₂ 胶体晶体 · 提拉速度 → 颗粒层数 → 反射峰（证据题）
cards.source: Fookes, Polo Parada & Fidalgo, "A Robust Method for the Elaboration of SiO2-Based Colloidal Crystals as a Template for Inverse Opal Structures", Sensors 23, 1433 (2023), doi:10.3390/s23031433 (Europe PMC PMC9920682)；证据卡逐条记录原文位置（docs/assets/families/evidence/fookes2023-layers.json）
cards.attribution: 事实数据取自 Fookes et al., Sensors 23, 1433 (2023)（CC BY）（逐条转述，未转载文字或图）；证据卡见 docs/assets/families/evidence/。
cards.objective: 由对流组装的物料平衡模型估计不同提拉速度下的层数比，解释反射峰变高变窄的原因。
cards.size: 推理：SiO₂ 球直径（266 nm）。
cards.question: Colloidal crystals of 266 nm SiO2 spheres are grown on glass by vertical lifting deposition (convective assembly at the meniscus) from an ethanol suspension, and their reflectance is measured at 30°. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Fookes et al., Sensors 23, 1433 (2023); numbers as reported in the paper). Using the material-balance (Dimitrov-Nagayama) model of convective assembly, estimate the ratio of the numbers of deposited particle layers, k(0.28 µm/s) / k(1.66 µm/s), for the same suspension, and explain the change in the reflectance peak. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

options.label: A
options.value: k(0.28 µm/s) / k(1.66 µm/s) ≈ 5.93. Slower lifting deposits about six times more particle layers from the same suspension; with the lattice unchanged, the thicker crystal gives the taller, narrower reflection peak.

options.label: B
options.value: k(0.28 µm/s) / k(1.66 µm/s) ≈ 0.17. Slower lifting packs the spheres more tightly and changes the lattice spacing, which sharpens the peak; the number of layers stays the same.

options.label: C
options.value: k(0.28 µm/s) / k(1.66 µm/s) ≈ 5.93. Slower lifting packs the spheres more tightly and changes the lattice spacing, which sharpens the peak; the number of layers stays the same.

options.label: D
options.value: k(0.28 µm/s) / k(1.66 µm/s) ≈ 0.17. Slower lifting deposits about six times more particle layers from the same suspension; with the lattice unchanged, the thicker crystal gives the taller, narrower reflection peak.

A.reason: 数值按原文数据计算正确，结论即原文结论（Results 3.1: higher peaks from more particle layers at higher φ and lower v (Dimitrov-Nagayama)）。

B.reason: 数值来自错误做法（把层数当成随提拉速度增大（k ∝ v），比值颠倒。），结论也是原文排除的解释。

C.reason: 数值正确，但结论是原文排除的解释：两种速度下峰位都在约 540 nm，晶格间距没有变；变化来自层数。（Results 3.1 (peak position unchanged near 540 nm)）

D.reason: 结论措辞取自原文，但数值来自错误做法：把层数当成随提拉速度增大（k ∝ v），比值颠倒。

cards.source: Cuello, Cortes, Perozo et al., "The gating cycle of a K+ channel at atomic resolution", eLife 6, e28032 (2017), doi:10.7554/eLife.28032 (PMC5711375; PDB 5VK6, 5VKE, 5VKH)；证据卡逐条记录原文位置（docs/assets/families/evidence/cuello2017-collapse.json）
cards.attribution: 事实数据取自 Cuello et al., eLife 6, e28032 (2017)（CC BY 4.0）（逐条转述，未转载文字或图）；证据卡见 docs/assets/families/evidence/。
cards.objective: 由两种突变体同样开门、只有失活者过滤器塌缩，判断深度失活是选择性过滤器的塌缩。
cards.size: 推理：过滤器在 Gly77 处的亚基间距（0.6–0.8 nm）。
cards.question: The potassium channel KcsA was trapped with its intracellular activation gate held open by an engineered disulfide bond, and crystallized carrying either of two mutations that change C-type inactivation: E71A, which removes it, and Y82A, which speeds it up. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E5 from Cuello et al., eLife 6, e28032 (2017); numbers as reported in the paper). Which account of deep C-type inactivation in KcsA is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: Inactivation is the closing of the intracellular activation gate.

options.label: B
options.value: The collapsed filter is a crystallization artefact unrelated to inactivation.

options.label: C
options.value: Deep C-type inactivation is a collapse of the selectivity filter that happens while the activation gate stays open; a network of water molecules behind the filter stabilizes the collapsed conformation.

options.label: D
options.value: Inactivation comes from losing the potassium ion in the central cavity below the filter.

A.reason: 与 E1 矛盾：两种突变体的激活门都被交联固定在 22 A 的开放状态，失活发生在门开着的时候。（Results: both constructs are cross-linked open, at 22 A）

B.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：在同样的交联与结晶条件下，不失活的 E71A 过滤器并未塌缩，说明塌缩与失活相关而非结晶假象。（Discussion: the well-established non-inactivating E71A mutant prevented the collapse）

C.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Discussion: the non-inactivating E71A mutant prevented the collapse, so the deep inactivated state has a collapsed filter）。

D.reason: 与 E4 矛盾：失活态的中心空腔仍有离子，变化发生在过滤器本身（位点 2、3 失去离子并塌缩）。（Results: the inactivated structure still holds a density modelled as a cavity ion, while the filter itself has collapsed）

cards.size: 推理：通道各段内径（0.6–3 nm）。
cards.question: The cryo-EM structure of the anthrax protective antigen (PA) pore at 2.9 A resolution shows the channel through which the enzymes lethal factor and edema factor cross the endosomal membrane. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E4 from Jiang et al., Nature 521, 545 (2015); numbers as reported in the paper). Which description of how a substrate protein passes through this channel is consistent with all of these facts?

options.label: A
options.value: The substrate has to be fully unfolded to pass the phi clamp, and may form an alpha helix again in the wider throat and tube below it.

options.label: B
options.value: Lethal factor passes through as an intact folded domain.

options.label: C
options.value: The substrate passes the phi clamp as preformed alpha helices.

options.label: D
options.value: The substrate has to stay fully extended along the whole channel, because no part of it is wide enough for a helix.

A.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Main text: the clamp may only allow passage of fully unfolded polypeptides; throat and tube can accommodate an alpha helix）。

B.reason: 与 E1 矛盾：孔口内径约 20 A，容不下折叠结构域，更过不了 6 A 的夹子。（Main text: the mouth cannot accommodate folded domains）

C.reason: 与 E2 矛盾：phi 夹只有 6 A，比 alpha 螺旋还窄。（Main text: the 6 A clamp is smaller than secondary-structure elements）

D.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：夹子下方的喉部与管道有 12–18 A，足以容纳 alpha 螺旋。（Main text: the throat and tube (over 12 A) can hold an alpha helix）

cards.objective: 由缺少 β 桶的孔态颗粒与环的突变实验，判断 β 桶形成是结构域会聚的结果，pH 感受器是不含组氨酸的环。
cards.size: 推理：感受 pH 的环及其邻近相互作用（约 1 nm）。
cards.question: Anthrax protective antigen (PA) heptamers convert at endosomal low pH from a soluble prepore into a membrane-spanning pore. Cryo-EM maps of the pore are compared with crystal structures of prepores. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E5 from Jiang et al., Nature 521, 545 (2015); numbers as reported in the paper). Which account of the low-pH conversion is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: The beta barrel forms first and pulls the domains together, which then closes the phi clamp.

options.label: B
options.value: The 2beta10-2beta11 loop acts as the pH sensor and flips first; the domains then converge and assemble the phi clamp, and the beta barrel forms afterwards as a consequence, not as the cause.

options.label: C
options.value: Protonation of histidine residues in the sensing loop triggers the conversion.

options.label: D
options.value: The domain 2 / domain 4 interface is the pH sensor: breaking it is what makes the structure respond to acid.

A.reason: 与 E1 矛盾：有一类颗粒已经收拢并装好 phi 夹，却还没有 beta 桶，说明桶不是先形成的。（Main text (third layer); Extended Data Fig. 8）

B.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Main text (pH sensing and the three layers of conformational change); Extended Data Fig. 8）。

C.reason: 与 E4 矛盾：该环不含组氨酸，原文据此排除组氨酸质子化这一常见机制。（Main text (pH sensing): the loop possesses no His）

D.reason: 与 E5 矛盾：界面处的突变只移动 pH 阈值，并不取消 pH 敏感性；取消敏感性的是该环上的 Asn422/Asp425。（Main text (pH sensing): such mutations change the threshold but keep pH sensitivity）

options.value: Radius of the Phe427 ring in the prepore ~ 16.13 Å. The phi clamp is already present in the prepore and only needs the Phe427 side chains to rotate into place; the protein backbone does not move.

options.label: B
options.value: Radius of the Phe427 ring in the prepore ~ 14.00 Å. The ring is about 32 A across in the prepore, matching its 30 A hole, so the 6 A clamp cannot be made by side-chain rotation alone: whole domains must swing inwards, as the 15 degree rotation and 12 A displacement show.

options.label: C

options.label: D
options.value: Radius of the Phe427 ring in the prepore ~ 14.00 Å. The phi clamp is already present in the prepore and only needs the Phe427 side chains to rotate into place; the protein backbone does not move.

cards.attribution: 事实数据取自 Rasmussen et al., Nature 477, 549 (2011)（PMC 作者稿，仅使用事实与数值）（逐条转述，未转载文字或图）；证据卡见 docs/assets/families/evidence/。
cards.objective: 由纳米抗体的结合位置、电镜与 DEER 的独立证据，判断结构域位移反映无核苷酸状态的真实松脱。
cards.size: 推理：Gsα 两个结构域之间的位移（约 2 nm）。
cards.question: The crystal structure of the beta2 adrenergic receptor bound to an agonist and to the nucleotide-free Gs heterotrimer (3.2 A) shows the alpha-helical domain of Gs-alpha swung away from its Ras-like GTPase domain, by about 127 degrees. A nanobody, Nb35, had been added to make the complex crystallize. The attached evidence.txt gives the evidence (facts E1–E5 from Rasmussen et al., Nature 477, 549 (2011); numbers as reported in the paper). Which account of the displaced alpha-helical domain is consistent with all of these observations?

options.label: A
options.value: GDP is still bound in a closed nucleotide pocket, and the apparent displacement is a modelling error.

options.label: B
options.value: Nb35 pushed the alpha-helical domain aside, so the displacement is an artefact of the crystallization aid.

options.label: C
options.value: The two domains stay together in solution; only the crystal lattice pulls them apart.

options.label: D
options.value: Removing the nucleotide unlocks the two domains, so the alpha-helical domain becomes mobile; the position seen in the crystal is only one of the conformations it can adopt, selected by crystal packing.

A.reason: 与 E5 矛盾：制备时用 apyrase 除去了 GDP，而且 GDP 或 GTP 类似物会破坏该复合物，复合物本身就是无核苷酸状态。（Crystallization of the complex: apyrase removed the GDP, which otherwise disrupts the complex）

B.reason: 与 E1、E2 矛盾：Nb35 结合在 Gbeta 与 Ras 结构域的界面，既不接触也不与螺旋结构域重叠；无纳米抗体的电镜同样看到该结构域位置可变。（Fig. S6: Nb35 neither contacts the helical domain nor overlaps it after superposition）

C.reason: 与 E3 矛盾：溶液中的单颗粒电镜已经看到该结构域位置可变，并非晶体中才分开。（Fig. 1b: EM in detergent solution already shows variable positions）

D.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论（Structure of activated Gs: the position most likely reflects one of an ensemble of conformations, stabilized by crystal packing）。
